# Grading Insurance

> Grading Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for grading contractors, earthmoving companies, and site-preparation contractors in all 50 states. Coverage lines: general liability (third-party bodily injury & property damage on the job site), workers' compensation for grading & earthmoving crews, commercial auto for dump trucks and equipment haulers, equipment floater & inland marine (excavators, bulldozers, motor graders, scrapers, compactors), builder's risk for site preparation, umbrella / excess liability, and surety bonds (bid, performance, payment). A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [General Liability Insurance for Grading Contractors](/services/general-liability): The essential coverage every GC, developer, and municipality requires before mobilization.
- [Workers Comp for Grading & Earthmoving Crews](/services/workers-compensation): Equipment rollovers, crush injuries, trench collapses, and struck-by incidents with proper class codes.
- [Commercial Auto for Dump Trucks & Haulers](/services/commercial-auto): Dump trucks, lowboys, water trucks, and pickups on public roads, with motor carrier filings where required.
- [Equipment Floater & Inland Marine](/services/inland-marine): Excavators, bulldozers, motor graders, scrapers, and compactors in transit, on-site, and staged overnight.
- [Builder's Risk for Site Preparation](/services/builders-risk): Course-of-construction coverage for installed pipe, base, paving, and site improvements.
- [Umbrella / Excess Liability](/services/umbrella): Limits above GL, commercial auto, and employers liability — required by DOT and large developer contracts.
- [Surety Bonds for Contractors](/services/surety-bonds): Bid, performance, payment, and maintenance bonds that scale with the work you chase.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **grading contractors and earthmoving companies** (dirt work, site prep, pad building, road grading, utility trenching, mass grading) — not generic contractor coverage.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Featured service: General Liability (required by nearly every GC, developer, and municipality before a grading contractor mobilizes).
- Each page carries 20 niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
